# Packet — popol-vuh-018: The twins go down to Xibalba; the Xan names the lords; the Dark House (fols. 23v–25r)

The established text (pinned) follows, one paragraph per block. A unit's `t` is cut from it by script (a sentence, or a long sentence or litany cut at a syntactic joint; couplets never split).

¶1
Ta xe be cut huhun chi vvb chique, xe cah chi Xibalba. Libah chi xe cah chua cumuc; xe icou chi vi cut chupan halha zivan, xa chuxol ꜯiquin xe icou vi; are ri ꜯiquin Molai qui bi. Xe icou chicut pa Puhia, pa Quiquia, chacbal ta que chi qui ꜭux Xibalba; mavi xqui yicou, xa chirih vvb xe icou vi. Xe el chicu apanoc pa cahib xalcat be.

¶2
Xa xquetaam vi cut qui be Xibalba: queca be, zaqui be, caca be, raxa be. Chiri cut xqui tac vi hun chicop, Xan v bi; are camol qui ta xqui tac vbic. “Huhunal que a tio; nabe cha ti ri nabe cubulel, cha ꜩaconizah qui tiic conohel; xa vech vi cut cha ꜩubah vi v quiquel vinac pa be,” xuꜭhaxic ri Xan. “Vꜩ bala,” xꜭha curi Xan.

¶3
Ta xoc pa queca be; tacal cu chirih ri poy, aham che, nabe culel, e cautalic. Nabe cut xqui tio; mavi xꜭhavic. Xu ti chicu, ta xu ti chi v cab culel; ma chi vi xꜭhavic. Xu ti chicu rox; ca chi rox culel ꜭo vi Huncame. “Aqui!” xꜭha cut hun ta xtiic. “Ahi!” xꜭha Huncame. “Naqui, Huncame? Naquila mi xi tiouic? Xa hina quichila mi xi tiouic?” xꜭha chic v cab culel. “Naqui, Vvcub Came? Naquila mi xi tiouic?” xꜭha chi roo culel. “Ahi, ahi!” xꜭha na Xiquiripat. Xꜭha Vvcub Came chire: “Naquila mi xi tiouic?” xꜭha chic; xtiic v vacac culel: “Ahi!” “Naqui, Cuchumaquic?” xꜭha Xiquiripat chire. “Naquila mi xi tiouic?” xꜭha chic, ta xti v vvc culel. “Ahi!” xꜭha chic. “Naqui, Ahalpuh?” xꜭha Cuchumaquic chire. “Naquila mi xi tiouic?” xꜭha chic, ta xti chic v vahxac culel. “Ahi!” xꜭha chic. “Naqui, Ahalcana?” xꜭha chi Ahalpuh chire. “Naquila mi xi tiouic?” ꜭha chic, ta xti chic v beleh culel. “Ahi!” xꜭha. “Naqui, Chamiabac?” xꜭha Ahalcana chire. “Naquila mi xi tiouic?” xꜭha chic, ta xti chic v lahuh cubulel. “Ahi!” “Naqui, Chamiaholom?” xꜭha Chamiabac. “Naquila mi xi tiouic?” xꜭha chic, ta xti chic v hulah culel. “Ahi!” xꜭha chic. “Naqui?” ꜭha chic Chamiaholom chire. “Naquila mi xi tiouic?” xꜭha chic, ta xti chic v cablahuh culel. “Ahi!” xꜭha chic. “Naqui, Patan?” xꜭha chic chire. “Naquila mi xi tiouic?” xꜭha chic, ta xti chic roxlahuh culel. “Ahi!” “Naqui, Quicxic?” ꜭha Patan chirech. “Naquila mi xi tiouic?” xꜭha chic, ta xti chic v cahlahuh culel. “Ahi!” “Naquila mi xi tiouic?” xꜭha chic Quicrixcac; xꜭha Quicre chirech.

¶4
Quehe cut v bixic qui bi ri xqui biyh conohel chi quibil quib; xqui cut v vach, xqui biyh qui bi, huhun chi holoman v bixic cumal; are chi biyh v bi hun ri cubul chu xucut. Mahabi hun oc xqui zach v bi; quiz qui biyh qui bi conohel, ta xe ti rumal rizmal v vach v chec Hunahpu, xu mich vbic. Mana quiꜩih Xan ri xe tiouic; xbe tao qui bi conohel rumal Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

¶5
Catecut ta xebec, ta xe opon puch chila e ꜭo vi Xibalba. “Chi quihila ahau,” xꜭha ri cubulic, xꜭha hun tacchiinel. “Mavi are ahau ri, xa poy, aham che ri,” xeꜭha ta xe oponic. Catecut ta xe calainic: “Calata Huncame; calata Vvcub Came; calata Xiquiripat; calata Cuchumaquic; calata Ahalpuh; calata Ahalcana; calata Chamiabac; calata Chamiaholom; calata Quicxic; calata Patan; calata Quicre; calata Quicrixcac,” xeꜭha ta xe oponic. Ronohel xquiz cut v vach, xqui biyh v bi ronohel; mahabi hun xqui zach v bi.

¶6
Are ta xahauax chiquech, ma ta xcanai v bi cumal. “Quix cu vloc,” xe vꜭhax cut; xe rah oc chuvi tem; ma cu xcah. “Mavi are catem ri, xa chohim abah ri tem,” xeꜭha Hunahpu, Xbalanque; mavi xe chacatahic. “Vꜩ bala; xa ba hix pa ha,” xe vchaxic. Catecut ta xe oc pa Queꜫuma Ha; mavi xe chacatahic chiri.

¶7
Are nabe v tihobal Xibalba ri; xe oc vi que chi cu v ticaric qui chacatahic ta chic chi qui ꜭux Xibalba. Nabe xe oc pa Queꜫuma Ha. Catecut ta xbe yaoc qui chah ca tilovic, ta xoponic ruꜭ huhun qui zic rumal vzamahel Huncame. “Vae qui chah e,” cacha ahau; “chul qui ya chic ri chah zacaric, ruꜭ ri zic chul qui moloba,” cacha ahau, xꜭha zamahel ta xoponic. “Vꜩ bala,” xeꜭha cut. Ma cu xqui ꜩih ri chah; xa ꜫaꜫa hu ꜫex v vach xoquic, are v he caquix; quehe ri chah xquilo varanel. Are chi cu ri zic, xa ꜫaꜫa chicop xqui coho chuvi zic. Hun aꜫab chi yocouic cumal. “Mi xe cachaco,” xeꜭha varanel. Ma cu habi xquiz ri chah, xavi xere v vach; are cu ri zic, mahabi naquila xqui ꜩih chire, xavi xere v vach. Xbe yaoc cuꜭ ahauab: “Naquipa que vxic? Apa xe pe vi? Achinac xe ꜭaholanic, xe alanic? Quiꜩih ca catat ca ꜭux rumal; ma vꜩ ca qui bano chique. Halan qui vach, halan nai pu qui ꜭoheic,” xeꜭha chi quibil quib.

¶8
Ta xe tacon cut conohel ahauab: “Oho chahoc, ix ꜭaholab,” xe vꜭhaxic. Ta xe ꜩonox cut rumal Huncame, Vvcub Came: “Apa quix ix pe vi? Chi biyh tah, ix ꜭaholab,” xꜭha cut Xibalba chique. “Alaba xoh pe vi lo; mavi quetaam,” xa xeꜭha; mavi xqui biyh. “Vꜩ bala; xa ca beco ca chaah, ix ꜭaholab,” xeꜭha Xibalba chique. “Vꜩ,” xeꜭha. “Re ba chi ca coh ri va ca quic,” xeꜭha Xibalba. “Ma ta hare ta chi coh va que,” xeꜭha ꜭaholab. “Mahabi; are chi ca coh ri que,” xeꜭha chic Xibalba. “Vꜩ bala,” xeꜭha ꜭaholab. “He bala xa hu chil,” xeꜭha Xibalba. “Ma bala, xa holom coh.” “Ꜭha chic,” xeꜭha ꜭaholab. “Mahabi,” xeꜭha Xibalba. “Vꜩ bala,” xꜭha Hunahpu.

¶9
Ta xzac cu vloc rumal Xibalba, qui cu tacal chuvach v bate Hunahpu; catepuch ta xquil Xibalba ri zaqui toc ta xel chupan ri quic, chi ꜩininic xbe he chuva tac vleuh ri chaa. “Naquipala?” xꜭha ri Hunahpu, Xbalanque. “Xa camic qui vah chiquech? Ma ta xoh be i taca, ma ta pu xbe i zamahel? Quiꜩih tocob ca vach. Xa coh bec,” xeꜭha ꜭaholab chique.

## Establishment log (doubtful readings, letters chosen, supralinear words — the notes must say so)

# Establishment log — popol-vuh-018 (image 0056 from about line 26, 0057, 0058, 0059 to the foot)

Read 2026-11-27 by the routine's own model from source/pages/i0056 (from `ta xe be cut huhun`, mid-line), all of
i0057 and i0058, and i0059 to `… xeꜭha ꜭaholab chique.` (its last line but one), in strips of about seven lines at
0.9×, with 1.6–2× crops of doubtful words, checked word by word against Brasseur 1861 (OCR lines c. 24997–25400:
the end of his chapter 8 and his chapter 9 to `x-e cha qaholab chique`). Pillow in a scratch venv.

Start: `Ta xe be cut huhun chi vvb chique, xe cah chi Xibalba` (Brasseur's chapter 8 opening). End: `… Xa coh bec,”
xeꜭha ꜭaholab chique.` on 0059; the last line of 0059, `are ta cu xahauax chique`, begins a sentence that runs on to
0060 and is left for popol-vuh-019, which begins there. parts.json: 019 set to images 0059–0062 (was 0063–0065,
which would have left 0060–0062 unread); plan.md row updated. Image 0060 not needed.

Content: the twins go down to Xibalba with their blowguns, down the steep steps, across the river in the ravine
between the Molai birds, across the rivers Puhia (pus) and Quiquia (blood) on their blowguns, to the crossroads of
the four roads (black, white, red, green); they send the Xan ahead to bite the seated ones one by one; the effigy and
the wooden figure do not speak; from the third (Huncame) on, each lord cries out and the next asks his name, until all
twelve lords are named (the Xan was a hair from Hunahpu's shin); the twins refuse to greet the effigies, greet the
twelve by name, refuse the hot stone bench, and go into the Dark House; the first trial: pine torches and cigars to
be returned whole at dawn — they put macaw feathers for flame and fireflies on the cigars; the lords marvel; the
ball game is proposed and argued over (whose ball, the skull or the rubber), the lords throw first and the white
flint (zaqui toc) comes out of the ball; the boys protest.

Paragraphs: ours, at the sense joints (as 015–017). No heading in this stretch.

## Folios
Counting as 004–017 did (0056 = 23v): 0057 = 24r, 0058 = 24v, 0059 = 25r → `fols. 23v–25r`. The crop of 0058
carries `24` at the top left, which agrees with the count kept since 017's folio doubt.

## Later-hand marks (dark ink, not Ximénez's)
A later reader (probably Brasseur, who owned the manuscript) marked the text in black ink in four places. The image's
own text is followed throughout; his marks are not taken in:
- 0057 l.8–9: a bracket from after `xtiic` to before `naqui Huncame`, apparently marking `ahi xꜭha Huncame` for
  omission (Brasseur prints nothing there). Kept: Ximénez himself struck a `naqui` at that spot (pale ink) and then
  went on with `ahi xꜭha Huncame`, which is therefore his intended text.
- 0058 l.? (the greeting list): a stroke before `Ahalcana`, and a heavy blot over two or three letters in
  `Quic[..]rixcac` — the letters under it are illegible; printed `Quicrixcac`, as 0057 writes the name.
- 0058 near the foot: a dark underline under the first m of `queꜫum maha` (see README 5b below).
- 0059 l.~15–16: `mavi que|taam … xeꜭha` after `xꜭha cut Xibalba` — `taam` and `xeꜭha` are struck through; the struck
  words are not printed (`… xꜭha cut Xibalba chique.`). Brasseur omits them too. Whose stroke it is is not certain.
- Short dark dashes between speeches on 0059 (speaker separators) — ignored.

## README 5b corrections (recorded in QUESTIONS.md)
- 0058, greeting list: MS `calata cala xic` → printed `calata Quicxic` (the name as written twice on 0057; `cala` is a
  slip repeating the `cala` of `calata`; Brasseur Quiqxic).
- 0058, near the foot: MS `pa queꜫum maha` (m written twice across the word break) → printed `pa Queꜫuma Ha`, as
  written five lines above on the same page and in 010.

## Letter-forms (as in 017)
- t written like h: `xqui tio` (MS looks `xquiho`), `cha ti ri` (`chahri`), `tiic` (`hiic`), `xu ti` ×2 (`xuh'`),
  `xi tiouic` throughout (`xih'ouic`), `xti` throughout (`xh'`), `v ticaric` (`vh'icaric`), `xe ti rumal` (`xeh'`),
  `ca tilovic` (`cahilovic`), `catem` (`cafem`). Read as t where Brasseur has t.
- r like v: `xꜭha chi roo culel` (MS looks `chivoo`; B. r'oo), `xꜭha curi Xan`.
- a/u: `chua cumuc` (MS looks `camuc`; B. cumuk; 010 `vchi cumuc`).
- `hix` in `xa ba hix pa ha`: h with the stroke Ximénez puts over h/t; read `hix` 'go!' (B. h'yx; 010 has `Xa hix chi
  ha`).
- Tall z with a crossbar = ꜩ, short z = z: `cha ꜩaconizah` (both forms in one word), `cha ꜩubah`, `quiꜩih` ×2 ('true'
  and `quiꜩih tocob`), `xqui ꜩih` ×2 ('light'), `xe ꜩonox`, `chi ꜩininic`; `zivan`, `xqui zach`, `quiz`, `xquiz`,
  `zic`, `xzac`, `zaqui toc`, `vzamahel` with plain z.

## Letters decided against Brasseur / by Brasseur
- g-shaped = ꜭ: `ꜭo vi` ×2 (B. qo), `qui ꜭux` (B. qux), `qui ꜭoheic` (B. qoheic), `ꜭaholab` throughout (B. qaholab),
  `Ꜭha chic` (B. Cha-chic; MS g-shape clearly).
- ꜫ: `Queꜫuma Ha`; `xa ꜫaꜫa hu ꜫex v vach` (MS looks `xaꜫaꜫahu quexvach`; the second word's first letter looks
  like q — Brasseur's g decided ꜫ); `xa ꜫaꜫa chicop` (B. gaga); `Hun aꜫab` (MS looks `acab`; B. agab decided ꜫ).
- Plain c kept where the hand shows c and no ꜫ/ꜭ shape: `caca be` 'red road' (B. Caka; 010 printed ꜫaꜫa be — the
  hand here shows two plain c), `camol qui ta` (B. qamol), `ca catat ca ꜭux` (B. qatat), `tocob` (B. togob),
  `chi yocouic` (B. yogouic).
- `tacchiinel` (B. lakchiinel): the first letter has the crossed loop of Ximénez's t; doubtful — it may be l.

## Brasseur's order and wording against the image (image followed)
- The roll-call (0057): Brasseur rearranges speakers and adds `Ahi!` cries the MS does not have at `v cab culel`;
  he gives `Xahina quichina, x-cha-cut Hun-Came` where the MS has `xa hina quichila mi xi tiouic xꜭha chic v cab
  culel`. The MS is printed as written; the quotation marks are ours and only one reasonable division. The tags
  `ꜭha chic` (twice, without x-) are as written.
- 0059: `ri que` in `are chi ca coh ri que` (B. va ke; r/v doubtful). `Ma ta hare ta chi coh va que` (B. same).
- `xꜭha curi Xan` (0056/0057): 0057 begins `ꜭha curi`; the x is read in the flourish after `vꜩ bala` at the end of
  0056 (doubtful).

## Word division (ours)
`xi tiouic` (x-i-, as 017's `xi petic`), `mi xi tiouic`, `Xa hina quichila`, `camol qui ta`, `xqui cut v vach`,
`ca chi rox`, `xa ba hix`, `Ma ta hare ta`, `qui cu tacal`, `chuva tac vleuh`, `zaqui toc` (010 prints the knife's
name Zaquitoc; here it is the flint, lower case).
